headline: BOS @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.87 at SEA 4.27, with a projected total of 8.14. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved +0.48 runs while SEA moved +0.18, changing the projected margin by +0.30 runs. The projected total climbed +0.73, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Bryce Miller has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cole Young, Ceddanne Rafaela, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
